Help
This Pictometry viewer allows you to search through Boone county in oblique (angled) and orthographic (straight down) aerial views. The oblique veiws,which are avalible in all four cardinal directions, allow you to see elements and details which are difficult or impossible to see from an orthographic image.
Boone County Courthouse
Takes the viewer to the Boone County Courthouse and displays it at an oblique angle from the western view.
Export
Downloads your current map view, with annotations in PDF format.
Search Owner / Address / Parcel#
Searches the Parcel layer by owner name, parcel ID, state ID, or address. Moves viewing window to the first result and returns a list of other parcels identified by the search. Some Owner and Address searches look similar so to force an address search use ! as a prefix, to force an owner search use / as a prefix.
Location
Returns a continuous stream for the lat. lon. coordinates from the middle of the screen.
Locate
Allow the user to jump to a specific location within the County. Currently options are provided to jump to a specific Subdivision or Cemetery Location by picking an item from the list.
For more information or help contact us at: shoran@co.boone.in.us
